subject: U16 durable live-fusion event/route/receipt/anti-entropy persistence
global_delta: Make live-fusion causal uptake durable rather than infer it from transport. Persist source+event+content identity, route-plan mode, exact target projection epoch/hash, monotone DELIVERED->RECONSTRUCTED->PLAN_REVALIDATED->USED->LOCAL_EFFECT->VERIFIED_OUTCOME->REENTRY receipts, and anti-entropy checkpoint state. TARGETED_DELTA fails closed on stale/incomplete projection; DENSE_FANOUT remains the safer fallback. Receipt existence never mints truth, causal credit or effect authority.

checks: exact event replay can be idempotent
local_validation.limit: Not clean-checkout GitHub execution, not Hostinger evidence, not Andreas-target acceptance.

acceptance: all U16 unit invariants pass on self-hosted Linux/X64
exact tested SHA recorded in durable receipt

unifieddb.delta: Treat U16 as an additive candidate persistence surface for mesh-v2 events/routes/receipts/anti-entropy. Do not silently promote it into canonical storage until same-file-vs-isolated observer backaction and crash/recovery are measured.
unifieddb.next_test: Run no-observer vs same-UnifiedDB vs isolated-observer matched WAL/load test; measure p50/p95/p99 write latency, busy/retry, WAL/checkpoint growth, RSS/I/O and recovery.

harness.delta: Bind real live-fusion runtime delivery/replan/recovery actions to U16 stages so stale-work interruption can be proven instead of inferred.
harness.next_test: Crash after a simulated external effect but before semantic effect receipt; replay must produce zero duplicate effect while leaving the receipt gap observable.

claygraph.delta: Every TARGETED_DELTA route decision now carries the exact branch projection epoch/hash used for routing; stale/missing projection cannot silently count as current topology.
claygraph.next_test: Inject missing and false dependency edges; compare permanent miss, false interrupt, repair latency and dense-fallback frequency.

gwt.delta: Reuse the strict causal-observability separation: addressability/delivery are not reconstruction/use; use is not local effect; verified outcome precedes provenance-bound re-entry.
gwt.next_test: Verify that a delivered-but-never-used delta cannot receive downstream causal credit or learning authority.

claycode.delta: No BASE semantic redesign is requested. U16 supplies a concrete future executable counterexample surface for typed event identity, route plans, receipt stages and anti-entropy state once parser/IR packages are ready.
claycode.next_test: After current parser/IR closure, encode the U16 records in frozen Clay semantics and lower them without a second semantic architecture.

frank.delta: Frank remains the research subject. U16 may carry Harness invalidation/re-entry evidence around Frank, but cannot grant Frank self-Harness mutation authority.
frank.next_test: Replay a Frank-related invalidator through active work and verify replan before effect while authority remains proposal-only.

clayresearch.delta: Promote stronger networking as measured causal closure, not message density. Preserve C1/C4/C6 counterhypotheses: missing edges, observer backaction and overcoupling remain open failure modes.
clayresearch.next_test: Adjudicate U16 only after real Ubuntu receipt plus fault matrix and matched observer-backaction results.

not_routed_as_material_delta.hyperposition: No new Hyperposition mechanism beyond already-distributed recipient-set uncertainty; existing branch feedback remains sufficient.
not_routed_as_material_delta.emergenz: No new emergence claim; U16 is persistence/observability infrastructure and connectivity still does not imply emergence.
